answer: Because the timing is recorded against the lantern challenge, the walnut audit can replay the ridge history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 202 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The per-identity price is 101 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
